teaser: Six in the morning, the house still dark, and you are moving through it anyway. You are a life path six, the nurturer number, carried through an ISTJ, the type built on order and duty, and this crossing announces itself before anyone else opens an eye. Lunches get packed, coffee gets started, the day gets planned before it starts, and none of it looks like devotion from across the room — it looks like a checklist. What stands out here is how quietly the caring work and the dutiful work agree to be the same work, done the same way, every day, without a word spent on explaining it.
excerpt: A hand reaches across a diner booth at closing to collect the last of the dishes before the other person has finished the sentence they were saying.
